_comment: Single source of truth for the transparent suitability rubric. Every number used by src/scoring/scorer.py comes from this file; see docs/SCORING.md for the rationale behind each value. Change values here, never in code. The SHA-256 fingerprint of this file is shown on every report so a score can be reproduced with exactly the same configuration.

semantic_normalization._comment: Raw cosine similarity of all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings is rescaled linearly from [low, high] to [0, 1] and clipped. low/high are the 5th/95th percentiles of the similarity over all 2,383 de-duplicated dataset pairs (computed without using any labels; see reports/results/v2/semantic_bounds.json).

ranking.tie_rule: Candidates whose overall scores are equal at the displayed precision share the same rank (standard competition ranking 1, 2, 2, 4). Within a tie, rows are listed alphabetically by file name for display only; this order carries no meaning.
